units.source_text: 男人同翻来覆去的沙子作着斗争，

en.t: The man struggled against the sand that kept turning over and over,

units.source_text: 即使在成为每天习惯的劳动中，

en.t: even in labor that had become a daily habit,

units.source_text: 略微感觉到某种充足感，

en.t: feeling a slight sense of fulfillment of some kind,

units.source_text: 但未必能断言这都是自虐的行为。

en.t: yet it could not necessarily be asserted that all of this was self-tormenting behavior.

units.source_text: 有这种痊愈的方法，也没什么不可思议的。

en.t: There was nothing particularly strange about such a way of healing.
